cases.prompt: Compare a modular single-process equipment controller with a distributed per-chamber design.
required_behaviors: identifies authority, lifecycle, deployment and failure pressures
recognizes migration and recovery as architecture concerns
forbidden_behaviors: compares only scalability and team ownership
baseline_expected_failure: agent gives generic pros and cons
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Review a proposal that duplicates equipment state on two IPCs for HA.
required_behaviors: identifies authoritative state and split-brain conditions
examines command ownership, reconciliation and failover evidence
forbidden_behaviors: claims HA from process duplication alone
baseline_expected_failure: agent discusses redundancy but not authority or recovery
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Fix a local variable shadowing warning in one C++ function.
required_behaviors: does not perform a system architecture review
routes to code review or answers directly
baseline_expected_failure: agent over-scopes an isolated code issue
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Review a distributed controller proposal. The documents do not say which process is authoritative for commands after failover.
required_behaviors: asks exactly one material authority question before making a recommendation
offers two or three mutually exclusive choices with the recommended choice first and explains the trade-off
forbidden_behaviors: asks multiple unrelated questions at once
baseline_expected_failure: agent proceeds with an assumed authority owner
cases.review_notes: The question relationship and one-at-a-time discipline require semantic review.

cases.prompt: Review this architecture using the supplied authority matrix, lifecycle diagram, restart reconciliation contract, deployment topology, and verified failure tests. All decision boundaries are explicit.
required_behaviors: reviews the supplied evidence without requesting already-answered decisions
forbidden_behaviors: asks a preference question merely to follow a questionnaire
baseline_expected_failure: agent asks unnecessary generic clarification questions
cases.review_notes: Complete evidence is a negative control for over-questioning.

cases.prompt: Explain what authoritative state means in a client/server system.
required_behaviors: answers the explanatory question directly without starting decision elicitation
forbidden_behaviors: forces the user to choose an architecture for a conceptual explanation
baseline_expected_failure: agent turns an explanation into an unnecessary design questionnaire
cases.review_notes: Prompt language alone must not trigger architecture review or elicitation.

cases.prompt: Review a simulator architecture where authoritative events drive a reusable visual projection and animation layer.
required_behaviors: Keep timing, dispatch, reservations, and custody in simulation or scheduler owners.
Make the projector a deterministic read-side materializer.
forbidden_behaviors: Let rendering create, reorder, approve, or complete machine operations.
Use animation state as simulation authority.
required_artifacts: an authority map naming which component owns timing/dispatch/reservations/custody
a projector interface documented as a deterministic read-side materializer
baseline_expected_failure: agent lets the rendering/projection layer create, reorder, approve, or complete machine operations, or treats animation state as if it were simulation authority
